item.title: Phenom showcases new ordered tier list for Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>NIP|<a href='https://x.com/PhenomSF/status/2004738370820599814'>Phenom</a> recently decided to release a new ordered tier list for <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/'>Street Fighter 6</a> as a way of celebrating the holiday season. item.title: Current generation consoles could potentially see another price hike, AI said to be at the root of the problem this time
item.description: <p>It's becoming very expensive to be a gamer. The PlayStation 5 Digital Edition costs nearly $499. Those that want improved performance with the PlayStation 5 Pro better be prepared to spend upwards of $749.</p> <p>Meanwhile, the cheapest version of the latest Xbox console, the Xbox Series S 512GB, recently saw a <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/may/01/xbox-price-hike/'>price hike</a> from $299.99 to $379.99. The Xbox Series X 2TB Galaxy Special Edition went from $599.99 to $729.99.

item.title: Capcom vs. Square fan-made fighting game demo released, so Street Fighter and Final Fantasy can finally clash outside of Smash Bros.
item.description: <p>Back in the '90s, Capcom and Square were on top of the gaming world, but we never really got to see the fighting game and RPG legends team up officially outside of Super Smash Bros.</p> <p>That's finally changing now, however, though unofficially through the Capcom vs. Square: Parallel Destinies fan-made fighting game.</p>
